name: How long does a comfort height toilet installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a comfort height toilet installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard comfort height toilet installations can be completed within 2 to 4 hours. This timeframe includes removing the existing toilet, preparing the area, installing the new toilet, connecting the water supply, and testing for leaks. The duration can extend if unforeseen issues arise, such as needing to replace a faulty flange, repair subflooring, or if complex plumbing adjustments are required. We aim for efficient service with minimal disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical comfort height toilet installation takes 2 to 4 hours, assuming no major plumbing or structural issues.
